desc: 开盖气垫主图、环形卖点盘、蜂窝微距与空位参数卡的底妆详情页套图
name: 海绵气垫BB霜清透裸妆款

shots.intent: 首屏用一眼可辨的开盖气垫与饱满粉体光泽拿下点击，交代这套图讲的是什么。
shots.textZone: 顶部居中一行主标题位「{selling_point_1}」，紧贴其下一条细副标题位「{callout_1}」，落在空白板 #F2E4DE 上；产品四周与底部不留文字

shots.intent: 用一圈空白卖点圆盘把这款气垫的主要主张一次性交代清楚，承担主图一秒法则。
shots.textZone: 顶部一行主标题位「{selling_point_1}」；六枚圆盘中四枚各留一个短标签位「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」，其余两枚保持空白

shots.intent: 把出油脱妆、厚重假面、纹理粗糙、干皮卡粉四类日常困扰摆成四格，先戳问题再给方案。
shots.textZone: 顶部一行主标题位「{selling_point_1}」；四格下方各一条短标签位「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 用三组同机位同光的空白对照格承接试用测评屏，把结论交给读者自己填。
shots.textZone: 顶部一行主标题位「{selling_point_1}」；每列右下角各一条小标签位「{callout_1}」与「{callout_2}」；仪器窗口与第三行两格保持空白

shots.intent: 用一指尖按压的海绵微距解释储粉与给粉结构，替卖点做机制背书。
shots.textZone: 环形刻度外上方一行主标题位「{selling_point_1}」，字色 #F2E4DE；刻度环与圆面内不留任何文字

shots.intent: 用梳开的粉体旋涡与两枚粉扑圆面证明触感与上妆均匀度，替代无法验证的材质话术。
shots.textZone: 上方一行主标题位「{selling_point_1}」；两枚圆盘外侧各一条弧形短标签位「{callout_1}」与「{callout_2}」，字色 #4A3B41

shots.intent: 承接产品解析屏的信息职能，用完全空白的参数行让商家后期自填，避免任何编造数值。
shots.textZone: 左侧一行主标题位「{selling_point_1}」；参数卡六行的左列标签位与右列数值位全部留空，仅一行示例位「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 给出真实梳妆台一角的手持取粉画面，让买家把自己代入日常补妆时刻。
用四格空白步骤图位交代按压、点涂、推开、加层的流程骨架，实操图留给后期实拍替换。
shots.textZone: 顶部一行主标题位「{selling_point_1}」；四格下方各一条说明位「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」，格内不留文字

shots.intent: 用整组实物平铺说清盒内有什么并留一枚空白印章框，用可见结构而非资质建立信任。
shots.textZone: 上方居中一行主标题位「{selling_point_1}」；空印章框与空纸盒图位内一律不留文字

shots.intent: 以暗场合盖气垫与一枚空白按钮收口整页，保留行动位但不承诺任何优惠。
shots.textZone: 上半部居中一行收口标题位「{selling_point_1}」，字色 #F2E4DE；产品下方一枚空按钮位「{callout_1}」，其余不留文字

style.backgroundSystem: three locked fields only: a matte rose-clay field #E3D3CE for hero and mechanism screens, a shell-white information card #FAF6F2 for grids and specification screens, and one deep berry-ink field #3A2A33 reserved for the closing and macro screens; every field is flat, horizonless and gradient-free, and consecutive screens swap between them
style.iconSystem: thin-line pictograms drawn inside blank circular discs hung on one hairline orbit ring in #C0876B, single stroke weight, never filled badges, never shields, never certificates
style.lightingSystem: broad diffused butterfly key from just above the lens axis with generous fill, controlled soft specular on the exposed sponge face, one believable contact shadow under every base, no hard cast shadow and no dramatic rim except a single thin lid-edge rim on the closing screen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent luminous base-makeup commerce system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte rose-clay field #E3D3CE, shell-white information card #FAF6F2, deep berry-ink closing field #3A2A33 and one rose-copper accent #C0876B, with #4A3B41 reserved for headline type on light fields and #F2E4DE on the ink field; neutral studio grade; broad diffused butterfly key from just above the lens axis with generous fill, controlled soft specular on the sponge face and one contact shadow under every base; matte laminated card surfaces with one shallow porcelain-tone disc tray #D8C3BC, no horizon line and no gradient; modern geometric sans-serif headline with one thin humanist label companion, three-layer text budget of one headline rail plus short label rails plus one button line; thin-line pictograms inside blank circular discs on one hairline orbit ring in #C0876B, never filled badges or certificates; the compact keeps the same opened hinge angle, the sponge face toward the lens and a stable product scale; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no dense body copy, no floating spheres or bubbles or mist, no gradients or horizon or scenery, no identifiable face, no numerals inside dials or meters or table cells.
noDrift: no colour palette changes outside #E3D3CE, #FAF6F2, #3A2A33 and #C0876B
no mixed fonts and no dense body copy blocks
no floating spheres, pearls, bubbles, splash, mist or vapor motifs anywhere in the set
no gradients, horizon lines, scenery or architectural backdrop
no identifiable face, portrait, eye or lip study in any panel
no numerals inside any dial, meter, table cell or badge
style.presentationRules: the compact always reads at the same opened hinge angle with the sponge face turned toward the lens, product scale locked across screens, lids and refill cases shown as plain unbranded shells with empty artwork rectangles
style.surfaceSystem: matte laminated card stock in shell-white #FAF6F2 and rose-clay #E3D3CE, one shallow matte porcelain-tone disc tray #D8C3BC, pale rose-clay cloth #D8C3BC for the single lifestyle corner
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for headlines with one thin humanist companion for labels; three-layer text budget per screen of one headline rail, up to four short label rails and one button line, all set in #4A3B41 on light fields and #F2E4DE on the ink field
